caption:
Silence in a meeting can mean many things. Don’t guess. Ask about the moment while it’s still fresh.

Save this for the one-on-one you keep putting off.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #peoplemanagement

slides.headline: Manager rules for the meeting where they went <u>quiet</u>.
In that talk, do these four things.
items: Name it: “You went quiet in there.”
Ask: “What was going on for you?”
Say the impact: “We needed your view.”
Set it up: “Next time, say if you disagree.”

slides.headline: Don’t fill in the story for <u>them</u>.
slides.sub: Ask about the silence before you decide what it meant.
